verdict.rationale: Connect delivers events through webhook endpoints, which a community user praises. It also has some built-in automatic behaviors: scheduled automatic payouts, automatic seller splits on charges, and no-code pricing strategies. However, there is no evidence of a user-definable rules engine that triggers actions on events; the user has to write their own webhook handler code to act on events. Missing for 10: native configurable event→action rules, no-code automation builder, documentation of rule conditions/actions, hands-on corroboration of automation depth.
